name: 沃尔夫冈·泡利
bio_short: 奥地利理论物理学家，量子力学的先驱之一。他因发现“泡利不相容原理”（`pauli_exclusion_principle_1925`）而获得1945年诺贝尔物理学奖，并预言了“中微子”的存在。他以严厉的科学批评而闻名（“这连错都算不上”）。
bio_short_en: An Austrian theoretical physicist and a pioneer of quantum mechanics. He won the 1945 Nobel Prize for the 'Pauli Exclusion Principle' (`pauli_exclusion_principle_1925`) and predicted the existence of the 'neutrino'. He was known for his rigorous critique of scientific ideas (famous for the phrase 'Not even wrong').
